title: Get Shorty
description: Relive this classic nineties crime comedy featuring a star-studded cast in its original physical format. This vintage tape comes in its authentic clamshell case, making it a perfect addition for collectors of cinematic memorabilia. Experience the nostalgic charm of analog playback with this well-maintained genre-bending favorite.

title: Earth Girls Are Easy

The vibrant cover art and nostalgic feel make it an essential addition for fans of quirky sci-fi and campy performances. This pre-owned edition offers a unique opportunity to own a piece of home video history from a celebrated era of pop culture.

title: Gaumont Treasures | Vol. 2

description: Film Noir: The Dark Side of Cinema II (Kino Lorber Blu-ray): three classic 1950s noir films - Thunder on the Hill, The Price of Fear and The Female Animal.

title: Miami Vice II
description: Feature-length home-video release of the second-season premiere of the TV series Miami Vice, "The Prodigal Son," starring Don Johnson and Philip Michael Thomas as Crockett and Tubbs.

title: My Bloody Valentine, April Fool's Day
description: Slasher double feature: My Bloody Valentine and April Fool's Day.

title: Cage'd In: Triple Feature
description: Nicolas Cage triple feature on 2 discs (about 5 hours), also starring Nicole Kidman, Eva Mendes, Josh Lucas, Malin Akerman, Cam Gigandet and Val Kilmer.

title: Star Wars Trilogy: IV, V, VI
description: The original Star Wars trilogy: Episode IV A New Hope, Episode V The Empire Strikes Back and Episode VI Return of the Jedi.

title: The Bourne Trilogy
description: The Bourne Identity, The Bourne Supremacy and The Bourne Ultimatum, starring Matt Damon.

title: Max Magician and the Legen of the Ring
description: A magical tale about young Max, a shy, bullied boy. His life is forever changed when he receives an ancient magical book that opens a mystical door into an enchanted kingdom where an adventure filled with warriors, elves, queens and sorcerers awaits.

title: The Shadow Collection: 8 Movies
description: Share the menacing shadows with eight sinister movies where supernatural entities prowl, human monsters stalk, and imagination runs wild. With selections covering extraterrestrials to the occult, revel in the terrifying possibilities presented by a dark and stormy night.

title: Double Feature: The Land Before Time 6&7
description: Double feature of The Land Before Time VI: The Secret of Saurus Rock and VII: The Stone of Cold Fire.

title: Missing in Action Triple Feature
description: Chuck Norris Triple Feature: Missing in Action, Missing in Action 2: The Beginning, and Braddock: Missing in Action III.

title: Mark Wahlberg: Rockstar, Perfect Storm, Three Kings, Corrupter
description: 4 Film Favorites starring Mark Wahlberg: Rock Star, The Perfect Storm, Three Kings and The Corruptor.

title: Electra
description: Elektra (2005): Marvel superhero spin-off from Daredevil directed by Rob Bowman, with Jennifer Garner as the assassin Elektra Natchios.

title: American Horror Stories 12 Movie Collection
description: Box set of 12 classic public-domain and cult horror films on 3 discs: Nightmare Castle, Point of Terror, Horror Express, Don't Answer the Phone, Bloody Pit of Horror, A Bucket of Blood, Don't Look in the Basement, The Driller Killer, Drive-In Massacre, Silent Night Bloody Night, House on Haunted Hill and Little Shop of Horrors.

title: Masters of Terror: 8 Horror Films
description: Eight-film horror collection.

title: Get Hard / Central Intelligence
description: Comedy double feature: Get Hard (Will Ferrell, Kevin Hart) and Central Intelligence (Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart).

title: Bubble
description: Jimmy is a young man who was born without an immune system and has lived his life within a plastic bubble in his bedroom... who pines for the sweet caresses of girl-next-door Chloe. But when Chloe decides to marry her high school boyfriend, Jimmy – bubble suit and all – treks cross-country to stop her.

title: The Three Muskateers
description: The Three Musketeers (1993): action-adventure comedy from Walt Disney Pictures and Caravan Pictures, directed by Stephen Herek.

title: Los Lonely Boys
description: Austin-based band Los Lonely Boys are blazing on Texican Style, a 96-minute concert recorded before a huge, wildly enthusiastic audience in the Texas state capitol in March, 2004. And the brothers Garza do it with what remains rock & roll's most basic and reliable format: the rock guitar trio. True, there's nothing earth-shatteringly original going on here; guitarist Henry, like many others from Texas and everywhere else, is channeling Jimi Hendrix via Stevie Ray Vaughan, with a little Carlos Santana on the side (Jojo is the outstanding bassist, while Ringo--his real name, by the way--plays drums, of course). But Los Lonely Boys bring something else to the party: good singing (all three are capable lead and harmony vocalists), and enough other influences, from Tex-Mex to the Beatles, to forge a distinctive, melodically appealing sound.

title: Beauty Shop / Leagally Blonde
description: Beauty Shop (2005) starring Queen Latifah and Legally Blonde (2001) starring Reese Witherspoon, packaged together as a two-movie DVD.

title: Space Rangers Chronicles 2
description: Space Rangers Chronicles 2: sci-fi action on VHS (Cabin Fever) starring Clint Howard.

title: Mom, Can I Keep Him?
description: Mom, Can I Keep Her? (1998): twelve-year-old Timmy Blair's furry new friend follows him home from school - a 500 pound gorilla.

title: Miss Julie
description: A footman seduces a count's daughter. Adaptation of August Strindberg's famous play.

title: TCM Sci-Fi Collection
description: Turner Classic Movies Greatest Classic Films Collection: Science Fiction.

title: Outrage
description: Tom Casey reports to the police some youngsters stealing from cars. He becomes the target of the 3 teenagers, who start to terrorise him and his family.

title: Faerie Tale Theater The Snow Queen
description: Shelley Duvall's Faerie Tale Theatre retelling of Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale. A young girl sets out to rescue her friend from the icy palace of the Snow Queen.

title: Wildside Crimea of the Century
description: An episode of the 1985 Western TV series Wildside, released on VHS.

title: The Dogfighters
description: Former Gulf War hero Rowdy Welles (Davi) is framed for murder by unscrupulous CIA boss Dick Althorp (Gazzara). As his price of freedom, Welles is ordered to undertake a deadly mission to destroy a nuclear processing plant in a foreign nation, owned by dangerous tyrant Lothar Krasna (Godunov).

title: The Hustle
description: Maya and Tony are a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde. Maya seduces businessmen while Tony copies their credit cards. It's a smooth con until one of their victims, Pierce, pulls a gun. Instead of killing them, Pierce offers the desperate couple a chance at the biggest score of their lives.

title: The Line / Staten Island
description: Blu-ray double feature: The Line and Staten Island.

title: Iron Man Trilogy
description: Iron Man, Iron Man 2 and Iron Man 3, starring Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark.

title: The Way Back
description: The Way, Way Back (2013): coming-of-age comedy-drama.

title: The Butterfly Effect Collection
description: The Butterfly Effect Trilogy: The Butterfly Effect (2004), Butterfly Effect 2 (2006) and Butterfly Effect 3: The Revelation (2009), psychological sci-fi thrillers about time travel.

title: Three Flavours Cornetto
description: Edgar Wright and Simon Pegg's Three Flavours Cornetto trilogy: Shaun of the Dead, Hot Fuzz and The World's End.

title: Harry Potter - 8 Film Collection
description: The complete Harry Potter film series, all 8 movies from Sorcerer's Stone to Deathly Hallows Part 2.

title: Lord of the Rings Trilogy
description: Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings trilogy: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Two Towers and The Return of the King.

title: The Girl With the Dragon Tattoo
description: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.

title: Godzilla (2000)
description: An independent group of researchers called the Godzilla Prediction Network (GPN) actively track Godzilla as he makes landfall in Nemuro. Matters are further complicated when a giant meteor is discovered in the Ibaragi Prefecture. The mysterious rock begins to levitate as its true intentions for the world and Godzilla are revealed.

title: The Gift
description: Simon and Robyn are a young married couple whose life is going as planned until a chance run-in with Simon's high school acquaintance sends their world into a tailspin.

title: Peter Pan
description: Leaving the safety of their nursery behind, Wendy, Michael and John follow Peter Pan to a magical world where childhood lasts forever. But while in Neverland, the kids must face Captain Hook and foil his attempts to get rid of Peter for good.

title: Robin Hood
description: With King Richard off to the Crusades, Prince John and his slithering minion, Sir Hiss, set about taxing Nottingham's citizens with support from the corrupt sheriff - and staunch opposition by the wily Robin Hood and his band of merry men.

title: Oldboy
description: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.

title: Risk
description: Maya, a New York artist and model, meets Joe, a drifter. They begin a passionate affair. On an impromptu trip to visit Joe's sister in the country, Joe's inner demons begin to surface.

title: The Sixth Sense
description: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.

title: Secret Window
description: Mort Rainey, a writer just emerging from a painful divorce with his ex-wife, is stalked at his remote lake house by a psychotic stranger and would-be scribe who claims Rainey swiped his best story idea. But as Rainey endeavors to prove his innocence, he begins to question his own sanity.

title: Psycho (1998)
description: A young female embezzler arrives at the Bates Motel, which has terrible secrets of its own.

title: The Ninth Gate
description: A rare book dealer finds himself at the heart of a string of paranormal events when he is hired to find the last two copies of a text, The Nine Gates of the Kingdom of Shadows, capable of summoning the Devil.

title: Misery
description: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan. Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.

title: End of Days
description: Cynical bodyguard Jericho is hired by a man possessed by Satan, who is in search of his bride. When Jericho realizes what is happening, he must do everything he can to save the woman and the world.

title: Soylent Green
description: In the year 2022, overcrowding, pollution, and resource depletion have reduced society’s leaders to finding food for the teeming masses. The answer is Soylent Green.

title: Unbreakable
description: An ordinary man makes an extraordinary discovery when a train accident leaves his fellow passengers dead — and him unscathed. The answer to this mystery could lie with the mysterious Elijah Price, a man who suffers from a disease that renders his bones as fragile as glass.

title: Identity
description: Complete strangers stranded at a remote desert motel during a raging storm soon find themselves the target of a deranged murderer. As their numbers thin out, the travelers begin to turn on each other, as each tries to figure out who the killer is.

title: The Good Son
description: A young boy stays with his aunt and uncle, and befriends his cousin who's the same age. But his cousin begins showing increasing signs of psychotic behavior.

title: Don't Say a Word
description: When the daughter of a psychiatrist is kidnapped, he is horrified to discover that the abductors' demand is that he break through to a young woman, suffering from PTSD, who knows a secret six digit code number.

title: Copy Cat
description: An agoraphobic psychologist and a female detective must work together to take down a serial killer who copies serial killers from the past.

title: Panic Room
description: Trapped in their New York brownstone's panic room, a hidden chamber built as a sanctuary in the event of break-ins, newly divorced Meg Altman and her young daughter Sarah play a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with three intruders - Burnham, Raoul and Junior - during a brutal home invasion. But the room itself is the focal point because what the intruders really want is inside it.

title: Mary Reilly
description: A housemaid falls in love with Dr. Jekyll and his darkly mysterious counterpart, Mr. Hyde.

title: Deep Blue Sea
description: Researchers on the undersea lab Aquatica have genetically altered the brains of captive sharks to develop a cure for Alzheimer's disease. But there's an unexpected side effect: the sharks got smarter, faster, and more dangerous. After a big storm damages their remote research facility, they must fight for their lives.

title: Cloud Atlas
description: A set of six nested stories spanning time between the 19th century and a distant post-apocalyptic future. Cloud Atlas explores how the actions and consequences of individual lives impact one another throughout the past, the present and the future. Action, mystery and romance weave through the story as one soul is shaped from a killer into a hero and a single act of kindness ripples across centuries to inspire a revolution in the distant future. Based on the award winning novel by David Mitchell. Directed by Tom Tykwer and the Wachowskis.

title: Jack Reacher
description: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack. All evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody. The interrogation yields one written note: 'Get Jack Reacher!'. Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears. So begins an extraordinary chase for the truth, pitting Jack Reacher against an unexpected enemy, with a skill for violence and a secret to keep.

title: Flatliners
description: Five medical students experiment with "near death" experiences, until the dark consequences of past tragedies begin to jeopardize their lives.

title: Burnt Offerings
description: A family moves into a large old mansion in the countryside which seems to have a mysterious and sinister power over its new residents.

title: Queen of the Damned
description: Vampire Lestat awakens from his slumber and becomes a rock star. But chaos strikes when his music awakens Akasha, the vampire queen, who may not rest until she makes Lestat her new king.

title: The Frighteners
description: Once an architect, Frank Bannister now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent.

title: Cabin by the Lake
description: A screenwriter does research for his new script by actually kidnapping and drowning young girls. He then places them in his "garden" of other dead girls coming back daily to check on them. One girl narrowly escapes and the other bodies are found leading to an ingenious plot to try and capture the killer.

title: Bats
description: Genetically mutated bats escape and it's up to a bat expert and the local sheriff to stop them.

title: Altered States
description: A research scientist explores the boundaries and frontiers of human consciousness. Using sensory deprivation and hallucinogenic mixtures from Native American shamans, he explores these altered states of cognizance and finds that memory, time, and reality itself are states of mind.

title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
description: Blonde, bouncy Buffy is your typical high school cheerleader. But all that changes when a strange man informs her she's been chosen by fate to kill vampires.
